## Summary

Describe the problem, the bounded change, and why this approach was chosen.

## Scope

- Owned paths:
- Preserved behavior:
- Explicit non-goals:

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include deterministic evidence for material claims.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not overwrite user-owned work.
- [ ] Relevant tests and evidence validators pass, or the exception is explained.
- [ ] Historical v0.2/v0.3 evidence packages remain byte-identical.
- [ ] New write ownership, resource locks, and evidence shapes are declared and tested.
- [ ] No global installer, external runtime, dependency, or permission expansion was introduced without an approved specification and ADR.
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` remain synchronized when factual documentation changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, nested Git metadata, generated runs, or unsanitized user evidence are included.
- [ ] The change is licensed under Apache-2.0 and any third-party attribution is present.
